We analyze conventional workarounds versus deploying sovereign commerce infrastructure you own outright.

content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Digital products

Conventional platforms like Gumroad or Paddle offer hosted stores with payment processing bundled in. They control your data, product delivery, and customer relationships. Workarounds like using a VPN to access PayPal or Stripe are temporary and violate terms of service. Sovereign infrastructure, by contrast, combines open tools into a stack you own: GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for logic, Supabase for storage, and NOWPayments for crypto payments. No platform controls your operations. No subscriptions. No geo-blocks. Full ownership from day one.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Platforms like Stripe and PayPal exclude entire countries due to regulatory or risk assessments, not technical limitations. Even if you use a VPN to bypass restrictions, your account risks suspension the moment your real location is detected. Sovereign stacks bypass this entirely by using globally accessible tools. GitHub, Cloudflare, and Supabase do not restrict users based on geography. NOWPayments processes crypto transactions from any country without KYC. The infrastructure is borderless by design, not by policy.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

PayPal holds funds for 21 days in restricted accounts and charges 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction. Stripe fees are similar but inaccessible to most countries. Crypto payments through NOWPayments cost 0.5% with no holding period. Transactions on BSC, Solana, or TRON networks cost under $0.10. Sovereign stacks automate payment verification and product delivery instantly. No platform skims fees. No funds held. The only cost is the initial deployment fee for your stack — after that, 99.5% of revenue is yours.
Stripe excludes 149 countries. Sovereign infrastructure includes all 195.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

On platforms like Gumroad, your store, customer data, and product files live on their servers. They can suspend your account or change their terms at any time. Sovereign stacks give you full ownership: your store runs on GitHub or Cloudflare Pages, orders are stored in your Supabase database, and files are delivered from your Google Drive or R2 bucket. Automation is handled by scripts you control. No platform can shut you down. No terms can change without your consent. You own the infrastructure, the data, and the relationships.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you need a temporary solution and accept the risk of account suspension, conventional platforms with VPN workarounds might suffice. If you want permanent infrastructure that cannot be taken away, deploy a sovereign stack. Start with the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) if you're selling 3 products or fewer. Upgrade to the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for SPF/DKIM/DMARC email security and 5 products. For full blueprints and templates, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes everything needed to build, deploy, and scale without restrictions.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

To sell digital products if Stripe is unavailable in your country, deploy a sovereign commerce stack using globally accessible tools. Host your store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Handle backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Store orders in Supabase or Google Sheets. Deliver files from Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Process payments with NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies and charges only 0.5% per transaction. This architecture bypasses geo-restrictions and gives you full ownership of your infrastructure.
PayPal can hold your funds for 180 days. Crypto payments settle in minutes.

If you're researching Stripe alternatives for Nigeria, Ghana, or other restricted countries, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides all 6 sovereign stack blueprints and 7 deployment templates. It includes step-by-step guides for integrating NOWPayments, configuring email security, and scaling your stack. Available for instant download at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. Built in Zimbabwe and pressure-tested against currency collapse, payment rejection, and financial isolation.
Your Deployment Checklist

Deploy your sovereign commerce stack in these steps: 1. Choose your hosting: GitHub Pages for simplicity or Cloudflare Pages for edge performance. 2. Set up backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. 3. Configure order storage in Supabase or Google Sheets. 4. Upload product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. 5. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. 6. Test end-to-end: simulate a purchase to ensure payment verification and file delivery work seamlessly. 7. Launch your store and retain full ownership of your infrastructure.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use Stripe or PayPal with a VPN in a restricted country?

Using a VPN to access Stripe or PayPal in a restricted country violates their terms of service. Your account risks suspension, and funds may be held for up to 180 days with no appeal. Sovereign infrastructure bypasses this risk entirely by using globally accessible tools that do not restrict users based on geography.
What are the fees for processing crypto payments?

NOWPayments charges a 0.5% fee per transaction. Recommended networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON cost under $0.10 per transaction. No platform skims additional fees, and no funds are held. You retain 99.5% of revenue after the payment processor's fee.
Do I need technical skills to deploy a sovereign stack?

Basic familiarity with web tools is helpful but not required. The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) and Edge Commerce Stack ($197) are deployed for you within 48 hours. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes full blueprints and templates for self-deployment, with detailed documentation for each step.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?

NOWPayments operates as a payment processor, not a platform you depend on. If their service is unavailable, your store remains operational — you simply lose the ability to process payments until service is restored. Your infrastructure is decoupled from any single provider.
Can I scale a sovereign stack to handle thousands of products?

Yes. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes a scaling playbook for expanding your stack to handle high volumes. Use Cloudflare Workers for serverless scaling, Supabase for database management, and R2 for file storage. The architecture is designed to grow with your business without platform limitations.
Platforms rent you access. Sovereign stacks give you ownership.
